correctness.rationale: The directed overlap graph has X_ab, Y_ab, Z_abc vertices, balanced degrees d=q-2 on X/Y and 1 on Z. Contracting X→Z→Y gives the parity lift of K_q nonbacktracking digraph. Its two components for q=3 preclude an Euler tour; q>=4 yields a connected Eulerian graph. Ihara/Bass determinant (t²−1)^e(t−d)(t−1)(t²+t+d)^(q−1), with e=q(q−3)/2, combined with the directed matrix-tree theorem gives τ=q^(q−2)d^(3q−2)(q−3)^(q²−3q+1)(q−1)^(q²−3q). BEST counts one tour per cyclic rotation through a fixed distinct arc, multiplying by ((q−3)!)^(2q(q−1)). The q=4 value 1,327,104 and exact balance/language sizes q=3,4,5 independently checked. Distinguishes q≥4 from q=3 and includes labeled alphabet, rotation-only conventions. The finite checks do not prove the all-q spectral identity; the symbolic determinant argument does.
